tools.Name: CLI-Anything
tools.Description: A tool that automatically generates command-line interface harnesses for any software codebase, allowing AI agents to interact with software via structured commands instead of brittle GUI automation.
tools.Use_Case: Enabling AI agents to programmatically control complex software like Blender, GIMP, LibreOffice, and Godot.

tools.Name: MarkItDown
tools.Description: A lightweight Python utility designed to convert various file formats (PDF, Word, Excel, Images, etc.) into Markdown specifically for use with LLMs.
tools.Use_Case: Preparing diverse document types as input for LLM analysis or RAG pipelines.

tools.Name: Hermes Agent
tools.Description: A self-improving AI agent framework featuring a closed-loop learning system, scheduled automations, and support for multiple messaging platforms and LLM backends.
tools.Use_Case: Building autonomous assistants that can learn from past interactions, manage long-term memory, and execute scheduled tasks across various messaging platforms.
